tool_versions.wla-dx: ---------------------------------------------------------------------- ---                WLA GB-Z80 Macro Assembler v10.6                --- ----------------------------------------------------------------------                 Programmed by Ville Helin in 1998-2008         In GitHub since 2014: https://github.com/vhelin/wla-dx                     : wla-gb 10.6 (19.11.2023)  USAGE: /src/wla-dx/build/binaries/wla-gb [OPTIONS] <OUTPUT> <ASM FILE>  OPTIONS: -c  Continue parsing after an error -d  Disable WLA's ability to calculate A-B where A and B are labels -h  Assume all label references are 16-bit by default (size hints     still work) -i  Add list file information -k  Keep empty sections -M  Output makefile rules -MP Create a phony target for each dependency other than the main file,     use this with -M -MF <FILE> Specify a file to write the dependencies to, use with -M -p  Pause printing after a screen full of text has been printed,     use this with -SX and -SY -q  Quiet -s  Don't create _sizeof_* and _paddingof_* definitions -SX <WIDTH> The number of characters per line in console (default 80) -SY <HEIGHT> The number of lines in console (default 24) -t  Test assemble -v  Verbose messages -v1 Verbose messages (only discard sections) -v2 Verbose messages (-v1 plus short summary) -w  Require labels to end in a colon -x  Extra compile time labels and definitions -I <DIR>  Include directory -D <DEF>  Declare definition  OUTPUT: -o <FILE>  Output object file -l <FILE>  Output library file  EXAMPLES: /src/wla-dx/build/binaries/wla-gb -M -t -o main.o main.asm /src/wla-dx/build/binaries/wla-gb -D VER=1 -D TWO=2 -v -o main.o main.asm
